name: United Heat Transfer Ltd
about: Incorporated in January 1995, United Heat Transfers Limited manufactures essential equipment such as heat exchangers, pressure vessels, and process flow skids.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Profile[1]
United Heat Transfer Limited (UHTL) manufactures heat exchangers, pressure vessels, and process flow skids for automotive, marine, power generation, and oil & gas industries. The company produces critical equipment for engines, maritime applications, mining trucks, and power generators, adhering to global standards like TEMA, ASME, and API in its manufacturing processes.

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Debtor days have increased from 73.5 to 102 days.
Company's cost of borrowing seems high
Working capital days have increased from 58.2 days to 155 days
